about.hero.title: About
about.title: Simone Hagen
about.intro: I'm Simone: enthusiastic, open-minded, compassionate, and a touch playful.
about.p1: My passion is guiding clients to bring order to their homes, uncover hidden gems, and create spaces that truly feel joyful and authentic.
about.p2a: Originally from Switzerland, I moved to Frankfurt with my family in 2025.
about.p2b: Over the past decade, I've lived and worked in six different countries. These experiences taught me how to adapt to new life phases and how much a calm, organised home can positively influence every area of life: confidence, relationships, work, health, finance and more.
about.p3a: Tidiness didn't come naturally to me. As a child, my parents would have found it quite funny to imagine me as a tidying coach.
about.p3b: My love for structure and visual calm developed later, especially after discovering the KonMari® Method.
about.p3c: Since 2022, I've been working as a certified KonMari® Consultant, turning my passion for organising into my profession.
about.p4a: It brings me great joy to offer personalised guidance and support people through important optimisation processes.
about.p4b: As a teacher, yoga instructor, and mum, I've learned the value of patience, sensitivity, and humor, and I bring all of that to supporting you on your journey.
about.p5: And personally... Besides tidying, yoga and teaching, these are a few of my favourite things:
about.li1: My husband and our two amazing boys
about.li3: Walking while chatting on the phone
about.li6: Harry Potter ("Very clean, aren't they, these Muggles?")
about.final-cta.title: Are you ready for a change?
about.final-cta.p1: Let's talk about how Simplify Living can help you create a home that truly feels good to you.
about.final-cta.p2: Get in touch now! Free and no strings attached.
